notes.title: Update 4.0
notes.notes:
4.0 update!111111!!!!!

This update brings a major feature. That is the ability to save your progress! No more starting from wave 1! None of that! Blech!

To save your progress, simply start a new game, play however long as you desire, and press "Save and Quit" from the pause menu (accessed by pressing ESC)!

Another update will be coming in a bit that brings a few new enemies/towers!

Enjoy!
